pre_ftl_deneb_system = {
	class = "sc_a"
	flags = { deneb_system primitive_system }
	max_instances = 1
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 5
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				any_system = {
					has_star_flag = deneb_system
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				any_country = {
					has_country_flag = human_3
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_fe_cluster = yes
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_first_contact_dlc = no
			}
		}
	primitive_system = yes
	init_effect = { }
	planet = { class = ideal_planet_class init_effect = { generate_pre_ftls_on_planet = yes } }
}

pre_ftl_shattered_ring = {
	class = "sc_g"
	flags = { ring_world_built shattered_ring_system }
	max_instances = 1
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = @spawn_system_slightlycommon
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				any_system = {
					has_star_flag = shattered_ring_system
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_federations_dlc = no
				has_first_contact_dlc = no
			}
			inline_script = "solar_system_initializers/initializer_modifiers_habitable_world_systems"
		}
	primitive_system = yes
	init_effect = { }
	planet = { class = pc_shattered_ring_habitable init_effect = { generate_pre_ftls_on_planet = yes } }
}
